players.product: baseboard management controllers (BMC) for AI servers

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier ASE Group (Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc.): ASPEED's board approved a 2-year capacity purchase agreement with ASE, running from 2027-01-01 to 2028-12-31, to ensure stable capacity supply; the company says securing a stable source of capacity supply benefits its future financial and business development, and the purpose is its operating development needs. Other terms are not disclosed ('per the contract').
